fix.en: to be unable to; to be bad at
fix.note: One word for lack of ability or skill; circumstantial 'couldn't' is spaced: 못 했어요.
N + 중이다 = in the middle of N: 회의 중.

ex.en: I'm in a meeting right now.

ex.s: 이 두 개 중에서 뭐가 더 좋아요?
ex.en: Which of these two is better?
I'm driving now, so I'll call you later.

notes: Spacing: circumstantial 못 하다 spelled as 못했어요 (replaced example, clarified note); added missing 더 for 'better'.
